'''Kitan''' is a palace maid from [[Mayene]].

==Activities==
At the [[Last Battle]], Kitan helps tend to those wounded in the fighting at the [[Field of Merrilor]]. She takes Lady [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron|Berelain]] to [[Galad Damodred]], who is grievously wounded, but is alive.

Berelain orders Kitan to call for an [[Aes Sedai]] who can [[Healing|Heal]] Galad.{{ref/book|14|37}}

==Trivia==
*Kitan is named after Tracie McFarlin, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''. Her username at TarValon.net was Kitan Tataru.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
